source_title: Make The World Safe For AI
summary: This March 18, 2026 interview is the source-level accounting for the already-public AI-limit / obedient-world lens point: Jiang ties Predictive History's model-testing method, AI non-sentience, human refusal, holy-empire language, China memory erasure, Iran-war prediction pressure, and his own public-risk transition into one high-pressure routing source.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: AI needs bounded goals, bounded parameters, clean data, and machine-legible inputs; the self-driving-car example turns malicious human refusal into the reason to remove human driving and make the world safe for AI.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The public Mass Society page already uses these refs for the exact anchor; this impact pass records why the source belongs there and prevents the held AI Obedience World seed from becoming an accidental duplicate page.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Jiang defines Predictive History as models tested by predictions that validate or invalidate them, then treats Trump 2024 and Iran-war pressure as public proof-test material.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The interview strengthens the Prediction method and Iran forecast-family trail, but it does not by itself resolve a ledger item; Prediction owns dated audit and later miss/shift/revision comparison.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: AI is not sentient in Jiang's technical account, but power can make people imagine sentience, demons, aliens, Jesus, or another sacred authority inside the interface.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The source supplies an earlier interview version of the sacred-interface mechanism later carried by AI As Control Surface and Eschatology; exact episode linking should wait for mark-level provenance, not generic AI mentions.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public as the March 18 machine-limit form: bounded AI cannot handle open-ended meaning or malicious human refusal, so the administrative temptation is to remove the human exception and discipline the environment around the machine.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Mass Society owns population and environment discipline. AI Control owns the answering or sacred interface; Attention owns mesmerized consciousness; Eschatology owns holy-empire and one-world-government role language; Free Will owns the deeper objection that eliminating choice cannot be salvation.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the interview as an early sacred-interface source: Jiang denies present AI sentience while warning that people can be trained to treat a bounded machine as sentient, demonic, alien, divine, or Jesus-like enough to command obedience.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: AI Control owns the interface and belief surface; Eschatology owns end-times role-script; Mass Society owns the administrative redesign; do not merge technical non-sentience and sacred image into a single unsupported claim.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use only if a future education chronology pass needs Jiang's autobiographical bridge from Yale alienation, Afghanistan disillusionment, Great Books teaching, 2016/2020/COVID shocks, and model-building into Predictive History.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Education owns formation and school trust; Prediction owns the model-testing rule; Secret Society or Proximity should not absorb this autobiographical path unless the active mechanism is factional coordination rather than schooling and method.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Treat the finish-line, last-war, and darkness-before-light passages as attributed eschatology pressure: Jiang frames destructive actors as religious zealots who read worsening conditions as acceleration toward a sacred endpoint.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Eschatology owns role-script and acceleration grammar; Prediction owns dated Middle East and U.S. civil-conflict claims; Chokepoint and Strategy own material Iran-war mechanisms.

new_lens_seeds.title: AI Obedience World
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: AI becomes politically powerful not because it is already sentient, but because its limits can justify redesigning the world until human ambiguity, refusal, memory, and open-ended meaning no longer disrupt machine systems.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The seed routes this source, the May 12 AI Apocalypse lecture, and later AI-control material without creating separate pages for AI God, self-driving cars, AI sentience, holy empire, or world-made-safe-for-AI examples.
new_lens_seeds.status: already recorded as held proposal seed under content/workflow/proposals/ai-obedience-world/proposal.md

chronology_notes.note: Published 2026-03-18, this interview is earlier than the May AI Apocalypse and late-May AI God classroom sources but later than the March 9 sacred-AI interview; treat it as a public interview bridge from AI technical limits into Mass Society / AI Control / Eschatology routing, not as the origin of every AI-control claim.

By 2026-03-18, Jiang presents Predictive History as a model-testing project and treats Trump 2024 and an Iran attack as fulfilled or live public tests, while American defeat in Iran remains unresolved and should stay in forecast-family comparison rather than ledger confirmation.

The closing passages make this a public-risk transition source: Jiang says viral fame makes speculative lectures unsafe, says he has sent in his resignation, and names book-writing as the next vehicle for refining ideas on the page.
